stops.name: Snjóölduvatn
stops.quote: Die wichtigsten Krater und Seen der östlichen Kraterreihe sind Snjóölduvatn, Ónýtavatn, Grænavatn und Litlisjór.
stops.english: The most important craters and lakes of the eastern crater row are Snjóölduvatn, Ónýtavatn, Grænavatn, and Litlisjór.

stops.name: Ljótipollur
stops.quote: Die meisten der Seen liegen in Kratern, die mit Grundwasser teilweise gefüllt sind, wie z. B. Ljótipollur und Hnausapollur.
stops.english: Most of the lakes lie in craters that are partially filled with groundwater, such as Ljótipollur and Hnausapollur.
